svg.text: matching type — player 1 really knows. Row sums of 1/2 are P(θ).

svg.text: Why θ alone is not enough

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Player 2 does not know θ, nor whether player 1 knows θ; one level up, player 1 must judge whether player 2 knows that he knows. The chain "I know that

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: you know" has no natural end. The type t folds the whole chain into a single object, and the prior P says which type goes with which state — the regress is

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: absorbed in one step, leaving an ordinary game of imperfect information.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: θ is how the world is; t is how a player thinks the world is. They are not the same thing, and the prior ties them together.
